mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for 6 months but 60-day forward returns do not exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A one-month surge in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers investor concerns about future rate hikes, compressing equity risk premiums and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but 5-day forward returns remain non-negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in the CPIAUCSL inflation index and FEDFUNDS rate signal policy uncertainty and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increasing AND FEDFUNDS increasing in the same month
failure_condition: Both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise while 20-day forward returns are positive (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion characterized by simultaneously elevated quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and production (INDPRO) indices signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO remain above thresholds but 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising employment (PAYEMS) signals accommodative monetary policy and labor market strength, fostering optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increasing AND FEDFUNDS decreasing in the same month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline while PAYEMS rises but 20-day forward returns remain non-positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the UNRATE below 3.0% indicates improving labor market conditions, reducing risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains below 3.0% but 5-day forward returns fail to be positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP) signals expanding economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises but 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal robust economic growth, enhancing market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increasing AND INDPRO increasing in the same month
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise while 20-day forward returns fail to be positive (p > 0.05).
